main.description: Send email via Microsoft 365 (Graph API). Policy-routed per deps.toml [gftdcojp_agent.auth]: all-internal recipients (@gftd.co.jp / @gftd.ai / @gftd.works / @gftd.group / configured Teams channel email domains) send directly; any external recipient → create draft in Outlook Drafts and return draftId + webLink for human approval (caller then calls sendDraft). For Teams channel posting, pass the channel email address as a recipient.

fromUpn.description: Sender mailbox UPN. Defaults to env DEFAULT_SENDER_UPN when omitted.

reason.description: When status=drafted, explains why (e.g. external recipients).

draftId.description: Present when status=drafted. Pass to sendDraft after human approval.

webLink.description: Outlook web URL for the draft. Present when status=drafted.
